meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 OpenRouter 的图像模型(默认 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview,也可选 FLUX.2 Pro 等)生成或编辑图片,并把结果保存成 PNG 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求生成照片、插画、概念图等非技术图片,或要修改已有图片时触发。流程图、电路图等技术示意图应改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 生成一张日落山脉的图片
把这张照片的背景改成蓝色
say.note: 用 --input 传入图片进入编辑模式

say.text: 用 flux.2-pro 生成一只太空里的猫

howto.what_en: Claude generates or edits images with OpenRouter models (default Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview, or FLUX.2 Pro and others), and saves each result as a PNG file.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for photos, illustrations, concept art or similar non-technical images, or want an existing image edited. For technical diagrams such as flowcharts or circuits, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a sunset over mountains
Make the background of this photo blue
Generate a cat in space using flux.2-pro
